Goals: Comprehensive correction 

Upper arch 
Stage 1 - perform all movements together 
1. Compress U78s 1-2mm
2. Expand U654 RHS and LHS
3. Do not allow movement of the upper labial segment in stage 1
Stage 2 - movement only after stage 1
1. Align upper 3-3 with upper proclination only 

Lower arch 
Stage 1 - perform all movement together 
1. Compress L78s 1-2mm
2. Expand LR456 LL456
Stage 2 - movements only after stage 1
1. Align L3-3 with proclination and mild IPR

Please correct deep OB with 
1. Extrusion of the posterior teeth 
2. Frog intrusion protocol for the L3-3
3. Anterior bite ramps

Please note 1.1 and 2.1 carry a bonded retainer/bridge abutment we are not prepared to disturb: absolutely no movement on those teeth, work around them.

Two updates to the request below: (1) the patient has declined lower-arch treatment — no lower tooth may move; (2) teeth 1.1 and 2.1 are ankylosed and must stay exactly where they are regardless of arch.
